name: listing.thumb
title: Field: listing.thumb
description: Meaning of the buyer-visible listing.thumb field.
text:
# listing.thumb

TL;DR:
- listing.thumb is the current user's like/dislike reaction for the listing.

What it means:
- like: the current user positively reacted to the listing.
- dislike: the current user negatively reacted to the listing.
- null: the current user has no thumb reaction.

Agent hint:
- Treat this as a personal reaction signal, not as public marketplace reputation.
